data.body:
S7.3.b cutover implemented. Disposition per read:

CUT-TO-SEAM (15): 3 load_config -> owned seam (ensures.py maybe_emit_pending_hint and project_ensures.py _effective_project now call config.compose_config(); push.py _push_mode now calls new config.resolve_push_mode(root), which reads sync.push LIVE per call via load_config(root).sync.push wrapping normalize_push_mode, ConfigError -> "always" -- preserves the import_ndjson REBAR_SYNC_PUSH defer coupling). git_fetch stall knobs (FLOOR/WINDOW/ATTEMPTS) -> config.resolve_stall_abort_limits/resolve_stall_attempts (git_fetch._positive_int removed). janitor 5x REBAR_GATE_* plus the dynamic os.environ.get at L73 -> config.resolve_janitor_tunables(defaults, root); JanitorConfig.from_env now RECEIVES resolved values (janitor._int_pref/_read_snapshot_table removed). repo_snapshot.store_root -> config.resolve_gate_tmpdir. env_identity.override_enabled -> config.resolve_allow_env_reidentify. lock.write_path_retries -> config.resolve_lock_retries(default, max) (see advisory below).

OWNED-IN-PLACE markers (5 lines, the cap): hlc.py L61 REBAR_HLC (subsystem-kill-switch), L71 REBAR_HLC_NOW (test-only-clock-injection); import_ndjson.py L216/L217/L395 REBAR_SYNC_PUSH (subprocess-env-control). No other listed source file carries a marker.

config.py resolvers added: resolve_push_mode (live per call, in config.py per the plan). The remaining resolvers (resolve_stall_abort_limits, resolve_stall_attempts, resolve_gate_tmpdir, resolve_allow_env_reidentify, resolve_lock_retries, resolve_janitor_tunables plus helpers _positive_int/_snapshot_table/_snapshot_int) live in rebar._config_sources (also an OWNED composition-root basename; this keeps config.py under the 800 LOC hard cap -- config.py is 721 LOC) and are re-exported from rebar.config, so callers use rebar.config.resolve_*. Env-name literals are inlined in these owned resolvers so gen_env_registry still documents them; docs/env-vars.md regenerated -- the 11 cut vars now attribute to _config_sources.py, while REBAR_HLC/HLC_NOW/SYNC_PUSH stay attributed to their in-place files.

write_path_retries(): per advisory, signature UNCHANGED. It reads the clamped retry count from config.resolve_lock_retries(_WRITE_PATH_RETRIES, _MAX_RETRIES) INTERNALLY, so the event_append.py and txn.py call sites that pass retries=write_path_retries() are untouched.

Extra marker (outside the 10 cut files): SyncConfig.push in _config_schema.py got a '# read-via: config.py resolve_push_mode()' marker to satisfy the sibling check_config_reads.py gate, because the .sync.push attribute-read site moved out of push.py into the config resolver. This is the established convention (cf. 'readonly ... # read-via: config.py mcp_readonly()') and _config_schema.py is NOT one of the 10 store/snapshot/io files, so the exactly-5-marker cap there is unaffected.

Semantics preserved: env>config>default for the [snapshot] janitor knobs; env>default for the stall knobs; [0, _MAX_RETRIES] clamp for REBAR_LOCK_RETRIES; live-per-call for push mode.

Test consumers: no tests/unit files needed edits. Every listed consumer injects via monkeypatch.setenv or explicit JanitorConfig(...) kwargs, and the relocated reads still read the same env vars (now from the owned config seam), so no injection path changed -- per the ticket's "only touch tests whose injection path actually changed".

Validation: (1) check_config_ownership.py exit 0, no output. (2) zero _store/_snapshot/_io rows remain in LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS. (3) make lint + make typecheck clean; complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0; module sizes under 800. (4) behavioral suites 578 passed / 9 skipped; one unrelated REPO_ROOT-leak ERROR from a foreign '.rp3_full.txt' artifact (another slice), which passes clean in isolation.
